verdict.rationale: Poly does run an official cloud sync. Files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer and sync back automatically, and journal notes are Markdown files synced to the Mind folder. There is no evidence of end-to-end encryption, and a community user notes the service reads and analyzes files on a remote server, which suggests the vendor can see content. Missing for 10: end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read, documented multi-device (including mobile) sync coverage, independent corroboration of sync behavior.
